When they drove the nails into His hands and feet, did she think back to the tiny fingers and toes that held hers so

They’re like this close 🤏🤏🤏 to understanding… and yet so far. @The View - since you all continue attacking a 28 year old with no desire for a different point of View, I’m just gonna invite all of you guys onto my show, ok?
